name: security
description: Security for web apps: OWASP-aligned code review (injection, XSS, CSRF, authz vs authn, mass assignment, uploads, secrets, dependency audit) mapped to PHP/Laravel and JS/Vue, PLUS design-phase threat-modeling (STRIDE, trust boundaries), a data-privacy (GDPR/CCPA) regulatory lens, and an api-auth lens (token model, OAuth2+PKCE, scopes). Includes /security:review and a security-engineer worker agent.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

cc_security_scan.title: Security write scan (CC_SECURITY_SCAN)
cc_security_scan.description: Warn when a write introduces a known-dangerous sink such as eval or shell-string exec: on or off. The environment variable CC_SECURITY_SCAN overrides this.
